client.description: Omit for hosted web checkout; native uses hosted app return. native_sheet returns a direct connected-account PaymentIntent for PaymentSheet and requires Idempotency-Key.

paymentIntentClientSecret.description: Sensitive payment capability. Keep only in memory; never put it in URLs, logs, navigation state or persistent storage.

paymentAttempted.description: Whether Stripe has observed a submitted payment attempt. Opening the payment form alone is not an attempt.

paymentAttemptedAt.description: Present only after Stripe reports a submitted payment attempt, never just from opening checkout.

orderTotalBani.description: Quoted checkout total including customer fees, in bani. Does not prove payment. Present on updated API versions.

paidTotalBani.description: Legacy alias for orderTotalBani. Also populated before payment; use status to determine whether a purchase completed.

orderId.description: The completed order that issued this ticket. Present on updated API versions; match this identifier to checkout confirmation instead of matching only the event.
